opportunities.title: A spell-checker could be built from open text
opportunities.detail: No spell-checker was found. FineWeb-2 holds about 240 million words of open web text, enough for a first word list.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: FineWeb-2 (240 million words); Wikipedia (16 thousand articles).

opportunities.title: No published speech recognition error rate
opportunities.detail: The language isn't in the published FLEURS error-rate breakdowns we track, so builders can't tell how usable open speech recognition is.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Amharic speakers are online today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: WAXAL (220 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (93 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: The building blocks for a voice assistant exist
opportunities.detail: Commercial speech recognition and a synthetic voice both exist, but no major assistant understands spoken requests in this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Amharic speakers are online today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: WAXAL (220 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (93 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); Belebele (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 1 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already read printed text in this language, and an open OCR model covers it.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (240 million words).

opportunities.title: 1 of 2 major AI assistant apps list this language
opportunities.detail: Some assistant apps already offer it. Listing it would tell speakers they can rely on it.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: Belebele (covers this language); FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Speech input is offered by 3 of 4 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already recognise this language. Open training data includes 327 hours of transcribed speech across 4 open datasets.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Amharic speakers are online today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: WAXAL (220 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (93 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Text-to-speech is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some cloud services already have a voice for this language, and an open model can speak it.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Amharic speakers are online today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: MMS text-to-speech (covers this language); WAXAL (220 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: The interface is translated on 2 of 3 major platforms
opportunities.detail: People can already use some phone and computer platforms in this language. Shared terminology would make the remaining ones faster to translate.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: Unicode CLDR (modern coverage).

opportunities.title: Translation is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: An open model and the FLORES-200 evaluation set already cover this language, so the main remaining step is a product launch.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: NLLB-200 (covers this language); FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: A keyboard layout exists but isn't on every major platform
opportunities.detail: A layout ships on 2 of 3 major keyboards. Contributing it to CLDR Keyboards, the open interchange format for layouts, would let any platform adopt it.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years. Ready to use: Keyman keyboards (covers this language); Unicode CLDR (modern coverage).

opportunities.title: Wikipedia has 59 active editors
opportunities.detail: A small editing community limits new open text. Edit-a-thons and translation drives with universities have grown communities elsewhere.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Amharic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 5.8 million within five years.
